description: The value \(m_R(\bar x,b)\) is at most \(b\). A smaller value is the least witness to \(R\); the value equals \(b\) exactly when no witness exists below \(b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch_spec.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (R : α → ℕ → Prop) (x : α)
  (b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch R x b ≤ b ∧
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch R x b < b →
        R x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch R x b) ∧
          ∀ i < Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch R x b, ¬R x i) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch R x b = b ↔ ∀ i < b, ¬R x i)
